posts.title: Chomp Up the Charts: Florida Jumps to No. 8 in AP, Coaches Polls
posts.excerpt: Florida’s 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss sent the Gators up 13 spots in the AP Top 25 and 14 in the Coaches Poll. They’re No. 8 in both.

image.alt: Chomp up the charts: Florida is No. 8 in the AP Top 25 and the Coaches Poll. Jon Sumrall leads the Gators onto the field. Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.

posts.title: Bound for the CFB Top Ten: Cue Up “Happy Days Are Here Again”
posts.excerpt: Happy days are back in Gainesville, and Buddy Martin thinks they may stick around. Why Jon Sumrall isn’t buying any of it.

image.alt: Jadan Baugh dives for his first touchdown against Ole Miss in The Swamp. Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.

posts.title: 10 Thoughts From the Sidelines: Florida 52, Ole Miss 28
posts.excerpt: Photographer Chris Spears had the best seat in The Swamp. Ten things the sideline told him about the Florida team that ran over No. 4 Ole Miss.
posts.author: Chris Spears

image.alt: The Florida Gators take the field against Ole Miss. Photo by Chris Spears.

posts.title: Beating Ole Miss was huge, but the Gators left at least 28 points on the field
posts.excerpt: Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28, but Franz Beard counts at least 28 points the Gators left on the field: an overthrown Vernell Brown III, an open Amir Jackson on fourth down, a 67-yard touchdown erased by a hold, and eight penalties for 92 yards.

image.alt: Left on the field: the points Florida left on the table in a 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss, charted on a football field.

posts.title: Postgame Analysis: Florida Gators 52, Ole Miss Rebels 28
posts.excerpt: Florida dominated No. 4 Ole Miss for a season-defining win, but Jon Sumrall says the Gators are still a work in progress. Loren Meadows on what he expected, what he got and what comes next.

image.alt: The Florida Gators take the field before kickoff against Ole Miss in The Swamp. Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media.

posts.title: Contenders, Not Hopefuls: Florida’s Rout of No. 4 Ole Miss Puts the SEC on Notice
posts.excerpt: Carlton Reese: With a 52-28 thrashing of No. 4 Ole Miss, Jon Sumrall’s Gators are no longer hoping to compete. They are a legitimate contender.

image.alt: GatorBait Media column graphic: Contenders, not hopefuls. Column by Carlton Reese.

posts.title: Baugh Game: Gators Run Over No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28 in The Swamp
posts.excerpt: Jadan Baugh ran for three touchdowns, Florida scored touchdowns on its first five possessions of the second half, and No. 21 Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28 to move to 4-0.

image.alt: GatorBait Media graphic: FINAL, Baugh Game.
